assessment: This important theoretical work deals with the problem of homeostasis of protein density within cells, relying on the Pump and Leak model. The model makes predictions both for growing and senescent cells, which they convincingly compare to experimental data on budding yeast. The authors further study the long-standing problem of nuclear scaling (the constant ratio between the nucleus and cell volume), and show that within their model it arises naturally from osmotic balance at the nuclear envelope, with metabolites playing a major role.
